typicalBarText: General hiring baseline expects consistent technical execution, clear bullet point ownership, and verified core competencies aligned with job requirements.
checklistItems: Verified core competencies with concrete project or work experience context
Quantified outcome metrics demonstrating personal ownership and impact
Clean resume structure with standard sections parsable by automated ATS systems
expectedSignals: Core professional competencies verified in context

scoredSignals.label: Verified Competencies in Context
scoredSignals.description: Skills demonstrated with concrete actions in work or project descriptions.

scoredSignals.label: Quantifiable Impact Evidence
scoredSignals.description: Evidence of metrics, outcomes, or completed milestones.

adviceCards.title: Add Quantified Metrics to Bullets
adviceCards.recommendation: Incorporate measurable numbers (%, $, time saved, user volume) to establish concrete impact.
